arxiv-2104-06411.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning, which acquires a policy maximizing long-term rewards, has been actively studied. Many studies have incorporated human knowledge into reinforcement Learning.

arxiv-2107-09039.description: Abstract We describe a systematic method to construct models of Chern insulators whose Berry curvature and the quantum volume form coincide and are flat over the Brillouin zone; such models are known to be suitable for hosting fractional Chern insulators.

pmc-11441317.description: Background and ObjectivesSelf-employment is a vital alternative to waged employment for older workers. Recent research has shown that employment transitions frequently occur when individuals approach retirement. However, evidence of how older people’s health changes when they switch between self and waged employment is lacking, particularly outside Western contexts.

pmc-11449674.description: ObjectivesNorth American coral snake envenomations can result in life‐threatening neurotoxicity. Their bites are relatively rare, making large studies difficult. Using the National Poison Data System (NPDS), we sought to investigate the epidemiological trends and clinical outcomes associated with North American coral snake bites over a 17‐year period.

pmc-11508924.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background/Objectives: High-grade gliomas are the most common primary malignant brain tumors in adults. These neoplasms remain predominantly incurable due to the genetic diversity within each tumor, leading to varied responses to specific drug therapies. With the advent of new targeted and immune therapies, which have demonstrated promising outcomes in clinical trials, there is a growing need for image-based techniques to enable early prediction of treatment response.

pmc-11712608.description: BackgroundAlthough Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a common cause of dementia, whether patients and caregivers have notions of its risk factors, behavioral aspects or care considerations is unclear.
